page: Microsoft Azure E20as_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the EASv4 family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 20 dedicated vCPUs across 10 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The instance features 160.0 GB of system memory, translating to a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It includes 328 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the E20as_v4 demonstrates strong single-core CPU performance, as evidenced by its stress-ng single-core score. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth remain in the average tier. Passmark memory testing highlights strong memory performance, while database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput fall within average parameters.

The instance exhibits performance limitations in demanding computational tasks, particularly in large-scale machine learning. LLM inference speeds for medium 7B models are weak, and prompt processing for large 70B models is poor, with no data available for 70B text generation. Consequently, this server is not suited for heavy AI workloads. It is highly appropriate for memory-intensive workloads, relational databases, caching layers, and enterprise applications requiring high memory density without dedicated GPU acceleration.
